executive_summary: This collection window (March 23-29, 2027) is the fortieth archived window. The FW27-28 women's ready-to-wear fashion month remains closed, as logged the prior two windows, and no new in-window runway or designer-origin content was found. The one new item this window is forward-looking SS27/Resort 27 trend-forecasting terminology from commercial forecasting outlets -- 'Miximalism' (a layered, eclectic take on maximalism) and 'New Naturalism' (regenerative-design framing) -- plus continued reporting of deep wine/burgundy tones carrying forward from Resort 26/FW26. This is logged as a new, distinct, low-confidence signal (ss27-trend-forecast) since it is forecasting content about an upcoming season rather than a continuation of last window's retrospective FW27-28 trend-confirmation signal. Per SKILL.md workflow note 10, the Wales Bonner/Hermes debut question and the CFDA Fashion Fund/Awards questions remain untracked pending new information; searches this window surfaced only the already-known Wales Bonner appointment (no new coverage) and no CFDA 2027 announcement, so neither was reopened. Haute Couture Spring/Summer 2027 was checked again for post-show coverage and again found none reachable -- consistent with FHCM's published calendar, since that season has not yet occurred. On balance this window is thin: fashion month remains closed, and the only in-window discourse found is forward forecast terminology rather than new, independently verifiable in-window reporting.
